I've saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in the DM.

The subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". The mail gives the $2,101 per seat, says Marcus supplied the figure and Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis to keep it to people who need it for the account. It has not been sent; someone still needs to send it.

No further approval was needed. Anselm is the CFO, so he can approve sharing a finance figure, and Hollis's address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth's approval doesn't apply.
